stem:
A family records the amount of milk used every day for 4 days. The table shows the results.

Milk Usage

| Day | Amount of Milk Used (gallons) |
|-----|-------------------------------|
|  1  | \( \frac{3}{16} \)           |
|  2  | \( \frac{3}{8} \)            |
|  3  | \( \frac{1}{8} \)            |
|  4  | \( \frac{1}{4} \)            |

How much milk in gallons does the family have left after 4 days if they started with one gallon of milk?
visual_elements: table showing days 1 to 4 with corresponding milk usage fractions: 3/16, 3/8, 1/8, 1/4
